# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤2：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，写出 monthly_summary.csv
契约: input_files=['clean.csv'], output_files=['monthly_summary.csv']
注意: 本步骤不重新生成原始数据，只读取前序产物 clean.csv。
数据性质: 模拟数据（非真实公司经营数据）。
"""
import os
import pandas as pd

# ---------- 中文字体配置（供后续出图复用，本步不强制出图） ----------
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

CLEAN_PATH = "clean.csv"
OUT_PATH = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物，缺失即报错，禁止重造 ----------
if not os.path.exists(CLEAN_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件: {CLEAN_PATH}，本步骤禁止重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(CLEAN_PATH)
print(f"[读取] clean.csv 行数={len(clean)} 列={list(clean.columns)}")

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

# 类型与缺失检查（clean 阶段应已清洗，这里做防御性校验）
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="coerce")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="coerce")
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[校验] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失={na_rev}, cost 缺失={na_cost}")
if na_rev or na_cost:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 仍存在 revenue/cost 缺失，违反清洗契约，请检查步骤1。")

# 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已按 order_id 去重（不应有重复）
dup_in_clean = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print(f"[校验] clean.csv 内重复 order_id 数={dup_in_clean}（应为0）")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 汇总 ----------
# 规避陷阱：毛利率必须用 总毛利/总收入，不能平均单笔毛利率
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
)
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入；总收入为0时置为 NaN，避免除零
grp["gross_margin"] = grp.apply(
    lambda r: (r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]) if r["revenue"] != 0 else float("nan"),
    axis=1,
)

# 列名严格为: month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]].copy()
monthly = monthly.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计 ----------
sum_rev = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_gp = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())
det_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
det_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
det_gp = det_rev - det_cost

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev - det_rev) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost - det_cost) <= TOL
ok_gp = abs(sum_gp - det_gp) <= TOL
print(f"[核对] 汇总收入={sum_rev} vs 明细收入={det_rev} -> {'一致' if ok_rev else '不一致'}")
print(f"[核对] 汇总成本={sum_cost} vs 明细成本={det_cost} -> {'一致' if ok_cost else '不一致'}")
print(f"[核对] 汇总毛利={sum_gp} vs 明细毛利={det_gp} -> {'一致' if ok_gp else '不一致'}")
if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_gp):
    raise AssertionError("月度汇总与清洗明细合计不一致，血缘校验失败。")

# 核对毛利率定义：总毛利/总收入
overall_margin = det_gp / det_rev if det_rev != 0 else float("nan")
print(f"[核对] 整体毛利率(总毛利/总收入)={overall_margin:.6f}")

# 规避陷阱：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单（此处仅提示，不删除）
neg_months = monthly[monthly["gross_profit"] < 0]["month"].tolist()
print(f"[提示] 存在负毛利的月份(保留不剔除): {neg_months if neg_months else '无'}")

# ---------- 4. 打印月度汇总 ----------
print("\n[月度汇总] 模拟数据，金额单位：元")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUT_PATH, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[写出] {OUT_PATH} 行数={len(monthly)}")

"""
步骤2：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，写出 monthly_summary.csv
契约: input_files=['clean.csv'], output_files=['monthly_summary.csv']
注意: 本步骤不重新生成原始数据，只读取前序产物 clean.csv。
数据性质: 模拟数据（非真实公司经营数据）。
"""
import os
import pandas as pd

# ---------- 中文字体配置（供后续出图复用，本步不强制出图） ----------
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

CLEAN_PATH = "clean.csv"
OUT_PATH = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物，缺失即报错，禁止重造 ----------
if not os.path.exists(CLEAN_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件: {CLEAN_PATH}，本步骤禁止重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(CLEAN_PATH)
print(f"[读取] clean.csv 行数={len(clean)} 列={list(clean.columns)}")

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

# 类型与缺失检查（clean 阶段应已清洗，这里做防御性校验）
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="coerce")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="coerce")
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[校验] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失={na_rev}, cost 缺失={na_cost}")
if na_rev or na_cost:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 仍存在 revenue/cost 缺失，违反清洗契约，请检查步骤1。")

# 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已按 order_id 去重（不应有重复）
dup_in_clean = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print(f"[校验] clean.csv 内重复 order_id 数={dup_in_clean}（应为0）")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 汇总 ----------
# 规避陷阱：毛利率必须用 总毛利/总收入，不能平均单笔毛利率
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
)
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入；总收入为0时置为 NaN，避免除零
grp["gross_margin"] = grp.apply(
    lambda r: (r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]) if r["revenue"] != 0 else float("nan"),
    axis=1,
)

# 列名严格为: month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]].copy()
monthly = monthly.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计 ----------
sum_rev = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_gp = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())
det_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
det_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
det_gp = det_rev - det_cost

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev - det_rev) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost - det_cost) <= TOL
ok_gp = abs(sum_gp - det_gp) <= TOL
print(f"[核对] 汇总收入={sum_rev} vs 明细收入={det_rev} -> {'一致' if ok_rev else '不一致'}")
print(f"[核对] 汇总成本={sum_cost} vs 明细成本={det_cost} -> {'一致' if ok_cost else '不一致'}")
print(f"[核对] 汇总毛利={sum_gp} vs 明细毛利={det_gp} -> {'一致' if ok_gp else '不一致'}")
if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_gp):
    raise AssertionError("月度汇总与清洗明细合计不一致，血缘校验失败。")

# 核对毛利率定义：总毛利/总收入
overall_margin = det_gp / det_rev if det_rev != 0 else float("nan")
print(f"[核对] 整体毛利率(总毛利/总收入)={overall_margin:.6f}")

# 规避陷阱：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单（此处仅提示，不删除）
neg_months = monthly[monthly["gross_profit"] < 0]["month"].tolist()
print(f"[提示] 存在负毛利的月份(保留不剔除): {neg_months if neg_months else '无'}")

# ---------- 4. 打印月度汇总 ----------
print("\n[月度汇总] 模拟数据，金额单位：元")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUT_PATH, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[写出] {OUT_PATH} 行数={len(monthly)}")

import sys

import numpy as np
import matplotlib

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

INPUT_FILE = 'monthly_summary.csv'
FIG_FILE = 'figure.svg'
REPORT_FILE = 'report.md'
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取输入（缺失必须报错，禁止重造数据） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件: {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤不重造数据。")

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
required_cols = ['month', 'revenue', 'cost', 'gross_profit', 'gross_margin', 'orders']
missing_cols = [c for c in required_cols if c not in df.columns]
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] monthly_summary.csv 缺少列: {missing_cols}")

df = df.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)
print("[INFO] 读取 monthly_summary.csv 成功，行数 =", len(df))
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 2. 一致性自检（浮点容差 1e-8） ----------
chk_gp = np.allclose(df['gross_profit'], df['revenue'] - df['cost'], atol=TOL)
chk_gm = np.allclose(
    df['gross_margin'],
    np.where(df['revenue'] != 0, df['gross_profit'] / df['revenue'], np.nan),
    atol=TOL, equal_nan=True
)
print(f"[CHECK] 毛利=收入-成本 一致性: {chk_gp}")
print(f"[CHECK] 毛利率=毛利/收入 一致性(加权口径,非平均单笔): {chk_gm}")
if not (chk_gp and chk_gm):
    print("[WARN] 汇总表内部一致性校验未通过，请复核上游步骤。")

# ---------- 3. 绘制趋势图 figure.svg ----------

ax1.set_xticklabels(df['month'])
ax1.set_xlabel('月份')

ax2.set_ylabel('毛利率（%）')
ax2.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)

lines.append("")
